digo_source: Pakia (2005) App. III, App. VI; Mgombato

teaser.en: Named after the hare, for reasons nobody can explain.
teaser.sw: Umepewa jina la sungura, kwa sababu ambazo hakuna anayeweza kuzieleza.

summary.en: Mtsungula is Stylosanthes fruticosa, a small perennial legume of grassland. Its Digo name means 'hare', though Pakia found no one who could say why.
summary.sw: Mtsungula ni Stylosanthes fruticosa, mmea mdogo wa kudumu wa jamii ya kunde unaoota nyikani. Jina lake la Kidigo lina maana ya 'sungura', ingawa Pakia hakumpata mtu yeyote aliyeweza kusema kwa nini.

about.en: Mtsungula is a low, bushy, somewhat woody herb with sticky-hairy stems. Its leaves are divided into three narrow, pointed leaflets. It bears small yellow pea-flowers tucked among bristly bracts, followed by tiny, hooked, one- or two-seeded pods.
about.sw: Mtsungula ni mmea mfupi, wenye matawi mengi kama kichaka na ugumu wa kimti kiasi, wenye mashina yenye vinyweleo vinavyonata. Majani yake yamegawanyika katika vijani vitatu vyembamba vilivyochongoka. Huzaa maua madogo ya manjano kama ya njegere, yaliyojificha kati ya vikapu-jani vyenye manyoya magumu, yakifuatwa na maganda madogo sana yenye ndoano, yenye mbegu moja au mbili.

where.en: It grows in dry grassland, bushland and on sandy or rocky open ground across tropical Africa and Asia.
where.sw: Huota katika nyika kavu, vichaka na kwenye ardhi ya wazi yenye mchanga au mawe kote katika Afrika na Asia ya kitropiki.

uses.en: Pakia records no Digo use. Stylosanthes species are well known as nutritious grazing for livestock.
uses.sw: Pakia harekodi matumizi yoyote ya Kidigo. Spishi za Stylosanthes zinajulikana sana kama malisho yenye lishe bora kwa mifugo.

culture.en: Pakia gives it as one of several plants named after animals where the reason is not clear, alongside Mtsalafu, 'safari ants', and Mgongolo, 'millipede'.
culture.sw: Pakia anautoa kama mojawapo ya mimea kadhaa iliyopewa majina ya wanyama bila sababu iliyo wazi, pamoja na Mtsalafu, 'siafu', na Mgongolo, 'jongoo'.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtsungula, named after the hare (tsungula), though the link between the two is unclear. Mgombato confirms tsungula as hare. In English it is sometimes called shrubby stylo; its scientific name is Stylosanthes fruticosa.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtsungula, lililotokana na sungura (tsungula), ingawa uhusiano kati ya viwili hivi haueleweki. Mgombato inathibitisha kwamba tsungula ni sungura. Kwa Kiingereza wakati mwingine huitwa *shrubby stylo*; jina lake la kisayansi ni Stylosanthes fruticosa.

reason.en: Also named after an animal for unclear reasons
reason.sw: Nao pia umepewa jina la mnyama kwa sababu zisizo wazi

reason.en: Pakia's Mgongolo, also named after an animal
reason.sw: Mgongolo wa Pakia, nao pia umepewa jina la mnyama
Mmea mwingine mdogo wa porini wa jamii ya kunde
